scope.actuator: Long fractional UPRO for bullish or SPXU for bearish

frozen_sensor.asia_cohort: prior calendar day 16:00 through signal day 00:30; exactly eighteen 30-minute Binance BTCUSDT spot bars
frozen_sensor.europe_cohort: signal day 01:00 through 08:30; exactly sixteen 30-minute spot bars
frozen_sensor.attention_on: Asia and Europe cohort imbalance signs agree and neither is zero
frozen_sensor.attention_off: opposite signs, an exact zero, or incomplete cohort
frozen_sensor.btc_direction_use: discard after testing sign agreement; it never selects UPRO versus SPXU

frozen_direction.prior_reference: immediately prior SPY session's exact 15:59 close
frozen_direction.bullish: attention on and current open strictly above prior close
frozen_direction.bearish: attention on and current open strictly below prior close
frozen_direction.no_trade: attention off, exact gap tie, or missing exact reference bar

execution.independent_feed: Databento EQUS.MINI SPY OHLCV-1m and UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m
execution.baseline_cost: full observed bid-ask spread at both fills
execution.cost_stress: one additional cent per share adverse at entry and exit

mechanism_contrasts.unfiltered_spy_gap: trade the same SPY cash-gap direction on every eligible session without the BTC attention gate
mechanism_contrasts.one_session_shifted_attention: use the immediately prior eligible equity session's BTC attention state with the current SPY gap direction

prohibited_after_results: use BTC flow sign to choose the ETF
change either BTC cohort or its clock
require BTC flow-price coherence after seeing outcomes
add a BTC imbalance or SPY gap magnitude threshold
add a weekday, month, year, volatility, spread, or price filter
use any crypto derivative or futures field
combine v32 with another candidate based on historical P&L
open holdout after any development-gate failure
